description: Comune di Spoleto - Abbonamenti ai parcheggi is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Umbria. Nel dataset vengono riportati il numero di abbonamenti emessi, suddivisi per parcheggi coperti e di superficie. Per i suddetti parcheggi vengono inoltre riportati gli ingressi degli autoveicoli suddivisi per anno. Coverage: Regione Umbria. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Umbria. Its tags are autoveicoli, mobilita, parcheggi. It offers 3 resource(s) in BWF. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
